DClutter 0.4.0
==============

Thanks for trying this out.

DClutter shows you one file at a time from your Downloads folder and lets
you keep it, put it in the Trash, or file it into a folder — with one key
or one swipe.


HOW TO OPEN IT (please read — the first launch will fail on purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Drag DClutter.app into your Applications folder.

2. Double-click it.

   macOS WILL REFUSE TO OPEN IT. This is expected. Keep going.

3. Open System Settings, go to Privacy & Security, and scroll all the way
   to the bottom. You'll see a line about DClutter being blocked, with an
   "Open Anyway" button. Click it.

4. Click "Open" to confirm.

That's the whole thing, and only on the first launch. Afterwards it opens
like any other app.


WHY DOES THAT HAPPEN?
---------------------

macOS blocks apps that haven't been signed with an Apple Developer
certificate, which costs $99 a year. This one hasn't been, yet. The
warning is macOS saying "I can't check who made this", not "this app is
broken or dangerous".

If you'd rather not take that on trust, the entire source code is public
and you can build it yourself:

    https://github.com/RokiTheWise/DClutter


WHAT IT DOES TO YOUR FILES
--------------------------

It only ever looks at your Downloads folder, plus any folders you
explicitly pick yourself.

  Keep      Does nothing at all. The file stays exactly where it is.
  Trash     Nothing is deleted straight away. Files are collected in a
            list, you review that list, and only then do they go to the
            Trash — where you can still get them back.
  File it   Moves the file into a folder you chose. Undo brings it back.

It never deletes anything permanently.


THE CONTROLS
------------

  Right arrow      Keep, next file
  Left arrow       Put in the trash pile, next file
  Space            Skip — it comes back at the end
  Up arrow         Choose a folder to file it into
  1, 2, 3          File it straight into folder 1, 2 or 3
  Return           Open the file so you can look at it properly
  Cmd + Z          Undo
  Cmd + Return     Review the trash pile and empty it
  ?                Show all the controls

You can also swipe left and right on a trackpad, and swipe up with two
fingers to choose a folder.


SOMETHING WRONG?
----------------

It's an early build, so quite possibly. Please tell me what happened:

    https://github.com/RokiTheWise/DClutter/issues
